## Company Overview

IMPRINT AI LLC is a Delaware-headquartered SaaS company that provides AI-powered workforce automation and field force management solutions. The platform enables organizations to digitize field operations, improve workforce productivity, automate business workflows, and provide real-time visibility into field activities.

The company is run by IIT and IIM alumni and serves customers across multiple industries and geographies.

Official Website: https://imprintai.us

Contact:
Email: contactus@imprintai.us
Careers: career@imprintai.us

## Company Mission

Simplify the workforce equation by providing intelligent, AI-powered software that improves productivity, visibility, compliance, and operational efficiency.

## Product Features

**Real-time Location Tracking** — Provides live visibility of employee movements and field activities.

**Attendance Management** — Tracks employee attendance, check-in, check-out, and productivity metrics.

**Analytics and Reports** — Provides dashboards and detailed operational reports.

**Dynamic Data Collection** — Enables data collection from mobile devices in online and offline modes.

**Job Scheduling and Task Assignment** — Assigns and tracks field activities and service requests.

**Business Card Scanner** — Captures and digitizes customer information.

**Digitized Knowledge Bank** — Provides centralized access to documents and training material.

**AI Assistance** — Provides instant user support and onboarding guidance.
